title: Bank payment processing system
description: A Spring Boot service that integrates with ICICI Bank for OTP, payment execution and status inquiry, and tracks every transaction. Payments that stay pending are reconciled automatically, and eligible failures are retried from a dedicated queue.

title: Event Subscription Tool
description: Configurable middleware that links business events to Camunda workflow steps, with event filtering, dynamic field mapping, correlation and idempotent duplicate handling. Messaging runs on Kafka topics and consumer groups, and subscription versioning is automated after each deployment.

title: RAG knowledge assistant
origin: Proof of concept at Caerus IT Consulting
description: An internal assistant that answers questions about company policies and handbooks. It retrieves relevant passages with semantic search, generates answers with a local LLM and keeps chat memory within a session.
result: Runs on a self-hosted model stack with Ollama.

title: Timesheet and status reporting platform
description: A full stack platform where employees log daily work updates with rich text and manage the lifecycle of their tasks. It makes it easy to track work updates across the organisation.
result: Debounced auto-save reduced redundant backend traffic by 35%.

title: AI Chatbot
description: A conversational interface that gives personalised responses and generates custom content using the Gemini API.

title: e-Voting System
description: A secure and transparent online voting platform with token-based authentication and a simple voting flow.

title: MemeStream
description: An Android app that fetches fresh memes from an API and lets you share them with friends in a tap.
